blurb: Cross between the living world and the spirit world. Night Shift is six courts. Overtime is the clock.

items.title: Night Shift
items.body: Six authored courts. A relic, then the exit, after each of the first five. The sixth is the boss.

items.title: Overtime
items.body: 180 seconds in the Old Churchyard. The clock is the run.

items.title: Quick Shift
items.body: On the board, and locked. Not built.

items.title: Move
items.body: WASD or the arrow keys. A touch stick on a coarse pointer.

items.title: Cross
items.body: Space, or a double tap. The dash is the attack.

items.title: Pause
items.body: P or Esc. Restart from the pause menu begins the whole run again.

items.title: Retry
items.body: R on Night Shift reloads the current court from the snapshot taken on entry. On Overtime, R starts a new run.

items.title: Two realms
items.body: A dash crosses worlds and sweeps the one you land in. Only a matching realm banishes.

items.title: Combo
items.body: Three second window, 100 points at the base, no cap.

items.title: Health
items.body: Three hearts. A hit costs one, then 1.1 seconds of invulnerability.

items.title: The other realm
items.body: Ghosts you cannot banish still drift toward you.

items.title: Wisps
items.body: Wisps shoot. Wanderers chase.

items.title: Carry
items.body: Health, score, and relics carry from court to court.

items.title: Exit
items.body: The exit arms once you stand outside it. A later step inside clears the court.

items.title: Death
items.body: A failed court retries that court. The Bell Tower ends the campaign when the Warden falls.

items.title: Pocket Watch
items.body: Dash cooldown x0.8. Does not stack.

items.title: Caretaker Key
items.body: Dash distance x1.25. Does not stack.

items.title: Spirit Bubble
items.body: Blocks one hit, even at full health, then pops. No extra heart.

items.title: Veiled Mourner
items.body: Slow, tanky chaser. The Last Ward.

items.title: Lantern Moth
items.body: Fast, erratic flier. Joins the churchyard's last round.

items.title: Bell Imp
items.body: Rings out shockwave pulses. The Bell Tower.

items.title: Gravedigger Shade
items.body: Leaves lingering pits. Hollow Grounds.

items.title: Wickling
items.body: Leaves a short burning trail. The Old Churchyard.

items.title: Ossuary Choir
items.body: Orbiting skulls take one dash before the body. The Catacombs.

items.title: Raven Wraith
items.body: Swoops in straight lines. The Bell Tower.

items.title: Bloom Wraith
items.body: Roots in place and sprays pollen shots. Forgotten Gardens.

items.title: Shackled
items.body: Slow. Its ball sweeps an arc. Hollow Grounds.

items.title: Hollow Mask
items.body: Blinks between realms. The Last Ward.

items.title: Title theme
items.body: The menu loop starts with the title.

items.title: Run score
items.body: The clean loop and the spirit reverb swap when you cross.

items.title: Loading
items.body: Both loops preload while the loading screen is up.

items.title: Hearts and clock
items.body: Hearts, the clock, the realm tag, and the lantern bar.

items.title: Tips
items.body: Night Shift freezes on the first tips until you dismiss them. Overtime skips them.

levels.objective: Three authored rounds. Round three adds a lantern moth pair. Clear the court, pick a relic, and step into the exit.
East and west portals, and a north-south pair. The fountain is solid. Bloom wraiths root and fan shots.
Realm walls. A living barrier stops the living world, a spirit barrier the other. Ossuary choir skulls take one dash before the body.
Four ward pillars. Ghosts attack the nearest living pillar. Three waves, then 500 points for each pillar still standing.
Banished ghosts drop souls. Carry them to the shrine. Twenty-five banked clears the court.
The Hollow Warden has 12 health. A dash in its realm deals one and flips which world it can be hurt in. No relic after.
